description: Gives a short plain-English definition of a data licensing term such as recurring license, exclusive license, de-identification, data provenance, data room or alternative data. If the term isn't in the glossary, returns the list of available terms. Use when someone asks what a data licensing term means.

term.description: The term to define, e.g. "non-exclusive license".
